The '''Judicial Service''' was a branch of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] judicial system. [[Lorz Geptun]] was an [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] with the Judicial Service, and was asked to investigate [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="SoM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
